name: net.blazarforce/blazar-polygon
title: Blazar Polygon plugin: BZB token, BlazarSwap DEX & trading rewards (Polygon)
description: Polygon-first swaps for agents: BZB via BlazarFeeRouter (earns trading rewards) and any other token via KyberSwap/LI.FI/Velora with token-safety checks on Polygon, Base and Ethereum; portfolio, tx status, gas, approvals, staking. Read-only + unsigned txs.

tools.name: blazar_overview
tools.description: Start here: BlazarForce overview. START HERE.

tools.name: blazar_quote
tools.description: Quote a Polygon swap (BZB, POL, USDC...). Price a Polygon swap (POL, WPOL, BZB, BBY, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, M421) before trading.

tools.name: blazar_compare_venues
tools.description: Compare a swap across venues. Compare one swap across venues before trading: the best BlazarFeeRouter route, the best route on each single venue (BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2, SushiSwap V2) through the fee router and as a direct pool swap, and a ParaSwap reference price (public API, no key).

tools.name: blazar_build_swap
tools.description: Build swap: approve + swap txs, simulated. One call to get everything needed to swap through BlazarFeeRouter: ordered txs[] (exact approve if needed, then swap), a plain-English summary per tx, an eth_call simulation of the swap (as if the approve were mined), the quote used, guards (minAmountOut, 3-minute deadline) and warnings[].

tools.name: blazar_check_limit
tools.description: Limit-order check (dry run). Off-chain limit-order check for a bot: is the executable BlazarFeeRouter price for this size (after fees and impact) at or above limitPrice (tokenOut per 1 tokenIn)? Returns triggered, gapBps and the exact blazar_build_swap args to use.

tools.name: blazar_plan_twap
tools.description: TWAP plan (dry run). Dry-run TWAP planner: splits a swap into N slices every intervalSeconds and compares with one swap now (impact per slice, estimated gain in bps, schedule with min-out per slice).

tools.name: blazar_any_quote
tools.description: Quote any token pair (Polygon, Base, Ethereum; aggregator). Quote ANY token pair on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param; symbol from the chain's curated or KyberSwap verified list, or any 0x address) through KyberSwap and LI.FI (same-chain only, compared; best output wins), with Velora (ParaSwap) as automatic fallback.

tools.name: blazar_token_safety
tools.description: Token safety check (honeypot, tax, verified list). Check a token on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param) before trading it: verified-list status (curated list, KyberSwap verified list), KyberSwap honeypot / fee-on-transfer flags, EIP-1967 upgradeable proxy, a simulated transfer that measures the real transfer tax, and for unknown tokens a simulated SELL back to USDC that catches blocked-sell honeypots.

tools.name: blazar_build_any_swap
tools.description: Build any-token swap (Polygon, Base, Ethereum): approve + swap, simulated. One call to swap ANY non-BZB token pair on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param) through the best of KyberSwap and LI.FI (Velora fallback; same-chain only, no bridges): token-safety check (refuses blocked tokens; unverified ones need allowUnverified=true), router allowlist, exact approve, slippage (max 300 bps) and deadline guards, USD-loss cap, recipient/value calldata checks, and an eth_call simulation of the swap before returning.

tools.name: blazar_portfolio
tools.description: Wallet portfolio: native, tokens, LP, staking, USD. One call for a wallet's balances with USD on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param).

tools.name: blazar_tx_status
tools.description: Tx status, receipt, decoded logs, revert reason. Did a tx land on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param; the hash only exists on the chain it was sent to)? Given a hash: not_found / pending / confirmed / reverted, block and confirmations, gas fee, decoded logs (ERC-20 Transfer/Approval, fee-router swaps, staking, pair Swap/Sync), per-token balance changes, decoded calldata for BlazarForce contracts, and the revert reason (replayed).

tools.name: blazar_gas
tools.description: Gas: fees, action costs, tx estimate (Polygon, Base, Ethereum). Current gas on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param): base fee, priority fee, maxFeePerGas and native/USD, plus the cost in native coin and USD of common actions (approve, swap, aggregator swap; on Polygon also stake, claim, staking v2 exit).

tools.name: blazar_allowances
tools.description: Approvals audit (tokens x spenders). Audit a wallet's ERC-20 approvals on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param): allowance() for each curated token (or tokens you pass) x each known spender (KyberSwap, LI.FI, Velora, Permit2, Uniswap, 1inch, 0x and the chain's main routers; on Polygon also BlazarFeeRouter, BlazarSwap router, staking v1/v2, QuickSwap, Sushi; or spenders you pass).

tools.name: blazar_build_revoke
tools.description: Build revoke txs (approve to 0), simulated. Build UNSIGNED revoke txs (approve(spender, 0)) on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param) for 1-10 token/spender pairs, each simulated from the owner, with the current allowance and gas.

tools.name: blazar_batch_calls
tools.description: Batch txs into one EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls. Turn txs[] from one or more build tools (same sender, same chain: Polygon 0x89, Base 0x2105 or Ethereum 0x1) into one EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request (version 2.0.0, atomicRequired) for smart wallets, plus the wallet_getCapabilities check to run first.

tools.name: blazar_chains
tools.description: Supported chains: Polygon (primary), Base, Ethereum. List supported chains: Polygon (137, primary: every tool, including BZB, BlazarSwap, staking, trading rewards and the fee router), Base (8453) and Ethereum (1) for the general tools only.

tools.name: blazar_pools
tools.description: BlazarSwap pools and reserves. List every BlazarSwap V2 pair on Polygon with live reserves.

tools.name: blazar_prices
tools.description: BZB price on each Polygon venue. BZB/WPOL mid price and USD value on BlazarSwap, QuickSwap V2 and SushiSwap V2, with pool depth in USD from the Chainlink-backed Blazar oracle.

tools.name: blazar_recent_events
tools.description: Recent swaps / pool events (log polling). Read recent onchain events by log polling: BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap (trader, tokens, amounts, USD) or one BlazarSwap pair's Swap + Sync (reserves and price).

tools.name: blazar_tokens
tools.description: Token list. Uniswap-schema token list (BZB, BBY, WPOL, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC, M421) with addresses, decimals and transfer-tax flags.

tools.name: blazar_contracts
tools.description: Contract addresses. BlazarForce contract addresses on Polygon (router, factory, fee router, staking, daily rewards, oracle, BZB) plus the pair init code hash.

tools.name: blazar_staking_info
tools.description: BZB staking status and APR. BZB single-sided staking (BlazarStakingRewards): status first (ACTIVE or REWARDS_ENDED with date), live APR from the reward rate, total staked, and optionally one account's stake, earned BZB and allowance.

tools.name: blazar_build_stake
tools.description: Build stake / withdraw / claim / exit. One call for BZB staking: ordered txs[] (exact approve if needed, then stake / withdraw / claim / exit), a summary per tx, a simulation, and warnings (e.g.

tools.name: blazar_staking_v2_info
tools.description: Staking v2 (multi-reward): status, rates, APR, position. BlazarMultiRewardStaking (staking v2: stake BZB, earn up to 5 reward tokens, no lock).

tools.name: blazar_build_staking_v2
tools.description: Build staking v2: stake / withdraw / claim / exit (gas-padded). One call for staking v2: ordered txs[] for stake (exact approve + stake), withdraw, claimAll, claimMany (defaults to only tokens with rewards), exit or emergencyWithdraw, each with a summary, a simulation, warnings, and a gas limit.

tools.name: blazar_daily_rewards
tools.description: Trading rewards: status and posted days. BZB daily trading-rewards status for swaps through BlazarFeeRouter: today's dayId, recently posted days with totals and claim deadlines, daily cap, contract balance, and scoring rules.

tools.name: blazar_trading_rewards_preview
tools.description: Trading-rewards leaderboard preview (estimate). Preview the BZB daily trading-rewards leaderboard for a UTC day from live BlazarFeeRouter AggregatedSwap logs, using the swap-desk rules: no minimum trade, no per-wallet cap, same-wallet round trips within 10 minutes netted, top 50 listed, top 25 paid fixed shares of the daily cap.

tools.name: blazar_daily_claimable
tools.description: Claimable trading reward. How much BZB one address can claim for one posted trading-reward day.

tools.name: blazar_build_claim
tools.description: Build trading-reward claim. One call to claim a posted BZB trading reward: the claim tx with a summary (amount and day), a simulation, and NOTHING_TO_CLAIM if the amount is 0.

tools.name: blazar_earn_strategies
tools.description: Ways to earn with BZB / POL (live reads). Earning options on BlazarForce ranked from live onchain reads only (no projections): BZB staking, BlazarSwap LP positions with reserves, trading rewards, and the BZB cross-venue spread.

tools.name: blazar_rank_earning
tools.description: Rank earning options; flag dead rewards. Rank BlazarForce earning options from live reads only: BZB staking, BlazarSwap LP fee APR (trailing 24h), daily trading rewards, staking v2.

tools.name: blazar_nft_collections
tools.description: BlazarForce NFT collections. BlazarForce NFT collections on Polygon (Sleepy Validators, Night Market Stubs, Crystal Moths): live name, supply, holder count, top holders, interfaces, sample token URI, site-stated ask, marketplace links.

tools.name: blazar_nft_holder
tools.description: NFT owner / holdings. Who owns a BlazarForce NFT (tokenId), or which token ids an address holds (owner), with metadata and marketplace operator approvals.

tools.name: blazar_nft_listings
tools.description: NFT listing info. Listing info for a BlazarForce NFT: owner, the site-stated ask, on-chain marketplace approvals (OpenSea Seaport conduit), and live Rarible orders only if RARIBLE_API_KEY is set in your env.

tools.name: blazar_build_nft_transfer
tools.description: Build NFT transfer (unsigned). Build an UNSIGNED safeTransferFrom for a BlazarForce NFT after checking ownership, with a simulation and warnings (irreversible, contract recipient, burn address).

tools.name: blazar_build_nft_approve
tools.description: Build NFT approve / revoke (unsigned). Build an UNSIGNED approve(tokenId) or setApprovalForAll (or a revoke with approved=false) for a BlazarForce NFT, with warnings for unknown operators and approve-all.

tools.name: blazar_deploy_templates
tools.description: Contract templates. List the contract templates this plugin can build deploy txs for: a fixed-supply ERC-20 (no owner, no tax) and a Synthetix-style staking pool.

tools.name: blazar_build_deploy
tools.description: Build deploy tx (ERC-20 or staking pool). One call to build an UNSIGNED contract-creation tx for a template, with named parameters per template, the predicted address, a simulation (eth_call creation) and verification settings.

tools.name: blazar_decode_tx
tools.description: Decode a tx before signing. Decode calldata for a tx to a BlazarForce contract or an ERC-20 approve, e.g.

tools.name: blazar_simulate_tx
tools.description: Simulate any tx (read-only). Dry-run any Polygon tx with eth_call + estimateGas from `from` (POL balance overridden, token balances real).

status: live: hosted read-only endpoint; not yet submitted to any registry
